subtitle: Proof-based routine builder
promotionalText: Pick a path, add your friends, and share the habits you're building. Schedule them, log real proof you did them, and watch your progress side by side.
description:
Pick a path, add your friends, and share the habits you're building.

Paths turns what you mean to do into what you actually do, and lets the people you trust see it happen.

PICK YOUR PATH
Start with what you care about: fitness, art, cooking, exploring or style. Your path shapes the habits you're offered and the world your progress is drawn in.

BUILD YOUR WEEK
Choose the habits that fit your goals and put them on your calendar, on the days and at the times that suit you.

PROVE YOU DID IT
Finishing a habit means showing it. Take a photo, record an audio note, write what happened, or let your iPhone or Apple Watch track the movement.

SHARE IT WITH FRIENDS
Add friends and you land in the same small crew. You see what everyone finished that day, and you can answer with a message or a sticker.

WATCH IT ADD UP
Every proof earns points and badges, and carries you further through a world built around your path.

MAKE IT YOURS
Dress your avatar and choose the backgrounds behind your calendar.

Build a routine for fitness, creativity, learning, or simply a better-run week.
